detail: The bpsec source-observation family is parked as one unit: books/bp-segmented-wire-job.lisp, books/bp-wire-primary-cursor.lisp, books/bp-wire-canonical-cursor.lisp, books/bp-received-raw-source.lisp, tests/bp_received_raw_registry_recording.lisp, tests/bp_segmented_wire_job_recording.lisp, tests/bp_segmented_wire_native_recording.lisp, tests/bp_wire_primary_cursor_recording.lisp, tests/bp_wire_canonical_cursor_recording.lisp. tools/bpsec_source_observation.py:17-19 and tools/bpsec_registered_source_observation.py:23 (and tests/test_commit_map.py:56-57) pin the four books by git hash from history, so the tip files are not their input; the tip books are loaded only by the five tests/bp_*_recording.lisp, which no runner or register names; the SCN catalog (tests/scenarios/catalog.json:7456,7463) and planning/requirements.json:1753,1760 cite the native_bpsec_* tests and tools, not the recording tests.
